name: Bregia

attributes.attribute: the latin form of the name Brega
the old latin label for the eastern plain

text: Bregia is the latin form of the name given to the eastern plain of Ireland. One word marks the same land between the Boyne and the Liffey as the native name Brega. The latin form appears in the books of the later writers who shared the same ground. So Bregia and Brega name one old district of the island.

okr.objective: Show the latin name Bregia in place of Brega.
key_results: Bregia is the latin form of the plain name.
Both words name the same eastern plain.
The form appears in later books of the island.
